newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas falls in line with OTC, volumes recover.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas falls in line with OTC, volumes recover.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures fell on Tuesday morning as prices caught up with the losses seen on the physical market the previous evening.

Trade was done in the three back months. March slipped by 0.30 pence to trade at 14.60 pence a therm, while April was also off by up to 0.335 pence to 11.50 pence, and May fell by up to 0.19 pence, with trade done at 10.90 and 10.875 pence a therm.

The total volume of trade was 75 lots, exceeding the volume done in the whole of the previous week, when only 55 lots were traded. And following the 45 lots done on Monday, the week's activity so far looks like a revival - even if it is from a low base the previous week.

And significantly, there were bids and offers posted across all periods by the close of the morning session, with a tight range in most months. Front-month June was 10.90/11.00 pence a therm by the close, and most other months saw less distance between bids and offers than in recent days.

Offers for all months with the exception of August and December were below the previous settlement price, showing that the futures market is still closely following the physical level, where prices have fallen this week.
